events.law-vs-smoker-punk-hazard: Law defeats Smoker and swaps Smoker's and Tashigi's bodies.
events.luffy-law-pirate-alliance: Law proposes a pirate alliance to Luffy to bring down an Emperor, and Luffy accepts.
events.vergo-identity-revealed: Vice Admiral Vergo is revealed to be an undercover member of the Donquixote Family.
events.shinokuni-unleashed: Caesar unleashes the lethal gas Shinokuni over Punk Hazard.
events.zoro-defeats-monet: Zoro stops Tashigi and defeats Monet himself with a single slash.
events.law-defeats-vergo: After Vergo defeats Smoker, Law cuts him in two along with the laboratory.
events.luffy-defeats-caesar-grizzly-magnum: Luffy defeats Caesar with the Gomu Gomu no Grizzly Magnum.
events.general-franky-debut: Franky debuts the General Franky robot.
events.law-ultimatum-doflamingo: Law demands that Doflamingo give up being a Warlord in exchange for Caesar; Doflamingo attacks the G-5.
events.aokiji-vs-doflamingo: Kuzan steps in to stop Doflamingo and save Smoker.
